endings.title: Static
endings.description: You transmitted fragments. Rumors, not proof. By morning the estate's lawyers had buried it under a hundred denials, and the dock was quiet again.

endings.title: Cracks in the Facade
endings.description: The names and dates went out on every channel. They couldn't deny the visits — only explain them. Investigations opened. The estate went dark.

endings.title: The Broadcast
endings.description: Guest log, manifest, access log, archive — corroborated and undeniable. The cover-up collapsed on live television. Nobody at the estate answered the door again.

endings.title: The Whole Truth
endings.description: You didn't just expose the visits — you followed the money. The ledger page named the account, the account named the network, and the network ran out of places to hide.
